description: The disaster statistics section of the National Disaster Reduction Center of China, part of the Ministry of Emergency Management, publishes regular releases on the national natural disaster situation. The listing read shows monthly releases (for example for April, May, July, August, October and November 2025), quarterly and half-year releases (the first quarter, first half and first three quarters of 2025) and an annual release for 2025, published on 15 January 2026, across 14 pages of earlier releases. The centre's site also covers risk monitoring, satellite and aerial remote sensing for disaster reduction, and international disaster information. Access to the releases is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Chinese, the releases are text bulletins, not downloadable tables, and the figures in each release were not read for this record. Coverage is China. It supports hazard exposure analysis and calibration of loss estimates for infrastructure affected by natural hazards across China; related records are DesInventar Sendai and the Munich Re NatCatSERVICE.
